note: The homepage's AI pictures: the hero carousel and the gallery slots. Edit this file, then run `uv run python tools/home_gallery.py`; it writes the blocks between the <!-- gallery:...:start --> markers of site/index.html and site/zh/index.html. Cameras are in cameras.json (viewer world metres, x east, z south, y up). Hero slides: `file` is the stem of their pictures in this folder (`-1280`, `-1920`, `-2560`, `-3840`, `-phone`), `short` the one line under the title, `ai` the full note (the lightbox), `reach` the wedge's length in metres if the default clamp is too short, `bg` the picture's average colour top and bottom (shown while it decodes). `frame` is how the picture shows the render: 16:9 the whole render, 3:4 a centre crop of a 16:9 render, 4:5 a crop of a 9:16 render at its full width; the map's wedge takes its width from it. `landmark` is the building the picture shows (an id of site/reconstruction/data/buildings_1860.geojson), `open` the panel the caption links to in the 3D view. See PLACEHOLDERS.md.

label.en: AI visualisation based on our 3D model, not a historical photograph
label.zh: AI 图像，依据我们的三维模型，并非历史照片

eyebrow.en: New in our model, Rounds 24 to 30
eyebrow.zh: 模型新增，第 24 至 30 轮

h2.en: The newest places, painted from our models.
h2.zh: 最新建模的地方，据模型而绘。

h2.en: The gardens from above, in every light.
h2.zh: 俯瞰全园，晨昏四时。

h2.en: A day in the gardens, from our model.
h2.zh: 园中一日，据模型而绘。
如手卷般 徐徐展开。

alt.en: AI visualisation: the gardens in their setting, the camps, villages and neighbouring gardens, with the Jade Spring hills and the Western Hills behind.
alt.zh: AI 图像：园林周围的营房、村落和邻近园林，远处是玉泉山和西山。

title.en: Beyond the walls

text.en: Camps, villages and the Western Hills.
text.zh: 营房、村落与西山。

title.en: The gardens from the south, a summer evening
title.zh: 夏日傍晚，从南面俯瞰园林

text.en: From high above the south, in low evening sun, looking north over the lakes and islands of 圆明园 Yuanming Yuan, with the plain and the Western Hills beyond.
text.zh: 夏日傍晚的斜阳中，从南面高空向北俯瞰圆明园的湖泊和岛屿，远处是平原和西山。

short.en: At this height the AI drew the layout freely: an impression, not a map.
short.zh: 在这样的高度，AI 自由地重画了布局：这是印象，不是地图。

ai.en: Only the camera comes from our model. At this height the AI has redrawn the lakes, islands and halls freely, and drawn the European palaces at the back far too large; the villages, fields, smoke and boats are its own. Take it as an impression, not a map.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型。在这样的高度，AI 自由地重画了湖泊、岛屿和殿宇，后面的西洋楼也画得太大；村庄、田地、炊烟和船都是它画的。请把它当作印象，而不是地图。

alt.en: AI picture: a vast garden of lakes, islands and halls among trees seen from high above in low golden light, boats on a broad lake in front, two large European-style stone palaces at the back and fields and hills reaching to the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：金色斜阳中从高空俯瞰一片广阔的园林，湖泊、岛屿和殿宇掩映在树林中，近处宽阔的湖面上有船，后面有两座高大的欧式石砌宫殿，田野和山一直延伸到天边。

title.en: 九洲清晏 Jiuzhou Qingyan, the emperor's island, at dawn

text.en: Looking north from high above the gate court, over the audience hall and the Front Lake to the island of the emperor's residence, a late-autumn morning.
text.zh: 深秋清晨，从宫门内院的高空向北，越过正大光明殿和前湖，望向皇帝起居的九洲清晏岛。

ai.en: The lakes, the islands and where the halls stand come from our model. The yellow and green glazed roofs are the AI's: the album of 1744 paints these halls with grey tiles. No photograph of them standing is known.
ai.zh: 湖、岛和殿宇的位置来自我们的模型。黄绿琉璃屋顶是 AI 画的：1744 年的《四十景图》里这些殿宇是灰瓦。目前不知道有它们完好时的照片。

alt.en: AI picture: an aerial view at dawn of a lake ringed by islands crowded with halls among autumn trees, a large yellow-roofed hall in the foreground and mist over the plain behind.
alt.zh: AI 图像：清晨俯瞰一片湖水，四周的岛上殿宇密布，掩映在秋树之间，近处是一座黄顶大殿，远处平原上有薄雾。

short.en: Lakes, islands and the halls' places from our model; the glazed roofs are the AI's.
short.zh: 湖、岛和殿宇的位置来自我们的模型；琉璃屋顶是 AI 画的。

title.en: 含经堂 Hanjing Tang in deep snow

text.en: The walled residence in 长春园 Changchun Yuan from the south-east, a winter morning, the lakes around it frozen.
text.zh: 冬日清晨，从东南面望长春园中的含经堂，四周的湖面已经结冰。

ai.en: The wall, the courts and the halls follow our model; their yellow glazed roofs are our guess (grade C). The people on the ice, the smoke and the fields are imagined, and the snowy mountains stand far nearer than the Western Hills do. No photograph of the compound standing is known.
ai.zh: 围墙、院落和殿宇依照我们的模型；黄琉璃屋顶是我们的推测（C 级）。冰上的人、炊烟和田地是想象的，雪山也画得比真实的西山近得多。目前不知道有这组建筑完好时的照片。

alt.en: AI picture: a walled palace compound with yellow roofs seen from above in deep snow, a marble bridge and frozen lakes with small figures on the ice, snowy hills behind.
alt.zh: AI 图像：从高处俯瞰大雪中一组黄顶的围墙院落，旁边有石桥，结冰的湖面上有小小的人影，后面是积雪的山。

short.en: Walls, courts and halls from our model, the yellow roofs our guess (grade C); the people on the ice and the near mountains are imagined.
short.zh: 围墙、院落和殿宇来自我们的模型，黄琉璃屋顶是我们的推测（C 级）；冰上的人和近处的山是想象的。

title.en: 福海 Fu Hai and 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai, a summer evening
title.zh: 夏日傍晚的福海与蓬岛瑶台

text.en: The island halls in the middle of the Sea of Blessings, seen from high over its south shore, boats on the water.
text.zh: 从福海南岸上空望湖心的蓬岛瑶台，湖上有船。

ai.en: The lake and the islets come from our model, the glazed roofs from the album leaf of 1744. The lotus, the boats and the buildings on the far shore are the AI's. No photograph of the island's halls standing is known.
ai.zh: 湖面和小岛来自我们的模型，琉璃屋顶依照 1744 年的画页。荷花、船和对岸的房屋都是 AI 画的。目前不知道有岛上殿宇完好时的照片。

alt.en: AI picture: a wide lake seen from above in evening light, a small island in the middle with glazed-roofed halls and lotus around it, boats on the water and willows on the shore.
alt.zh: AI 图像：傍晚的光线中俯瞰一片宽阔的湖，湖心小岛上有琉璃顶的殿宇，四周是荷叶，湖上有船，岸边是柳树。

short.en: Lake and islets from our model, the glazed roofs after the 1744 album; boats, lotus and the far shore are the AI's.
short.zh: 湖面和小岛来自我们的模型，琉璃屋顶依照 1744 年的画页；船、荷花和对岸是 AI 画的。

title.en: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang at dusk

text.en: The west front of the Hall of Peaceful Seas, its double stair around the basin of the water clock, seen from the west, low over the water.
text.zh: 从西面贴近水面望海晏堂西立面，双跑楼梯环抱着水力钟的水池。

ai.en: The front, the stair and the basin follow our model and the copperplate of 1786. The AI has left out the twelve seated bronze figures of the water clock and put stone lions on the stair; the lanterns, the attendants and the long pool in the foreground are imagined.
ai.zh: 立面、楼梯和水池依照我们的模型和 1786 年的铜版画。AI 漏掉了水力钟的十二尊青铜坐像，在楼梯上画了石狮；灯笼、侍从和前景的长水池都是想象的。

alt.en: AI picture: a two-storey European-style stone palace at dusk, its double stair lined with lanterns and stone lions around a basin with a shell fountain, reflected in a still pool where attendants light lanterns.
alt.zh: AI 图像：黄昏中的一座两层欧式石砌宫殿，双跑楼梯上排列着灯笼和石狮，环抱着一座贝壳喷泉的水池，倒映在前面平静的水面上，侍从正在点灯。

short.en: Front, stair and basin from our model and the 1786 copperplate; lanterns and people imagined.
short.zh: 立面、楼梯和水池依照我们的模型和 1786 年的铜版画；灯笼和人物是想象的。

title.en: The forecourt of 大宫门 Da Gongmen, an autumn morning
title.zh: 秋日清晨的大宫门前院

text.en: At eye level in the forecourt south of the main gate, looking north at the gate and the ranges on either side.
text.zh: 站在正门南边的前院里平视，向北看大宫门和两侧的房屋。

ai.en: The gate and the side ranges stand where our model of Round 19 puts them. The officials, horses and sedan chair are imagined; the roofs and trees are the AI's.
ai.zh: 大宫门和两侧房屋的位置依照我们第 19 轮的模型。官员、马匹和轿子是想象的，屋顶和树木是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a wide earthen forecourt in early autumn light, a stone-paved road leading to a gate hall with grey roofs, low halls either side, officials, horses and a sedan chair in the court.
alt.zh: AI 图像：初秋晨光中宽阔的土院，一条石板路通向灰瓦门殿，两侧是低矮的房屋，院中有官员、马匹和一顶轿子。

title.en: 福海 Fu Hai at dawn

text.en: Mist on the Sea of Blessings, looking across the water to 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai from a little above the lake.
text.zh: 晨雾笼罩福海，从略高于湖面的地方隔水望向蓬岛瑶台。

ai.en: Only the island's place and the direction of the view come from our model. The hall, the shore in front, the boats and the people are the AI's.
ai.zh: 只有小岛的位置和视线方向来自我们的模型。殿宇、近处的岸、船和人物都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: mist over a still lake at dawn, a yellow-roofed hall on a stone terrace at the water's edge, small boats with canopies, willows and pines framing the view.
alt.zh: AI 图像：清晨平静的湖面上飘着薄雾，水边石台上有一座黄顶殿宇，湖上有带篷的小船，柳树和松树环绕。

title.en: The west front of 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang, an afternoon

text.en: The double stair embracing the basin of the water clock and its twelve seated figures, in low afternoon sun.
text.zh: 午后斜阳下，双跑楼梯环抱水力钟的水池和池边十二尊坐像。

ai.en: The front, the stair and the basin follow our model of Round 14 and the copperplates. The people and their dress are imagined.
ai.zh: 立面、楼梯和水池依照我们第 14 轮的模型和铜版画。人物和服饰是想象的。

alt.en: AI picture: the west front of a European-style stone palace, a double stair curving down around a basin with a shell fountain, seated bronze figures along its sides, people in Qing dress in the court.
alt.zh: AI 图像：一座欧式石砌宫殿的西立面，双跑楼梯弯曲而下，环抱着有贝壳喷泉的水池，池边排列着青铜坐像，院中有穿清代服饰的人。

title.en: 大水法 Da Shuifa, the Great Fountain, playing

text.en: From the court in front: the niche, the water steps, the basin with the stag and hounds, and the two towers of jets.
text.zh: 从前面的广场看：石龛、跌水台阶、有鹿和猎犬雕像的水池，以及两座喷水塔。

ai.en: The niche, the steps, the basin and the towers follow our model of Round 15 and plate 15. The people, the parasols and the trees behind are the AI's.
ai.zh: 石龛、台阶、水池和喷水塔依照我们第 15 轮的模型和第十五幅铜版画。人物、伞和后面的树是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a carved stone fountain niche with water cascading down its steps into a basin with a bronze stag and hounds, tall jets either side, people in Qing dress with parasols in front.
alt.zh: AI 图像：雕花石龛，水沿台阶跌落到有青铜鹿和猎犬的水池中，两侧水柱高喷，前面是穿清代服饰、打着伞的人。

title.en: A night of lanterns by 福海 Fu Hai, imagined

text.en: Red lanterns along a hall on the shore under a full moon. The night is imagined, not a recorded festival.
text.zh: 满月之下，岸边殿宇挂满红灯笼。这是想象的夜景，不是记载中的某个节日。

ai.en: Only the viewpoint comes from our model, and loosely. The hall, the lanterns and the people are the AI's.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型，而且只是大致如此。殿宇、灯笼和人物都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a two-storey hall on a lake shore at night hung with rows of red lanterns, a full moon above, a small boat and floating lights on the dark water.
alt.zh: AI 图像：夜晚湖岸上一座两层殿宇挂满红灯笼，天上一轮满月，黑色的水面上有一条小船和漂浮的灯。

title.en: The forecourt of 大宫门 Da Gongmen in snow

text.en: The same forecourt on a winter morning, looking north to the gate.
text.zh: 同一个前院的冬日清晨，向北望大宫门。

ai.en: The gate and the side ranges follow our model. The walls across the court, the sedan chairs, the riders and the smoke are the AI's.
ai.zh: 大宫门和两侧房屋依照我们的模型。院中的墙、轿子、骑马的人和烟都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a snow-covered forecourt on a bright winter morning, a red wall with an opening before a gate hall, officials, sedan chairs and riders in the snow, bare trees white with frost.
alt.zh: AI 图像：晴朗冬日清晨积雪的前院，一道开有门洞的红墙后面是门殿，雪地里有官员、轿子和骑马的人，光秃的树挂着白霜。

title.en: The gardens from the west

text.en: From high above the west on an overcast autumn day, looking east over the lakes and islands to 福海 Fu Hai.
text.zh: 阴天的秋日，从西面高空向东俯瞰湖泊和岛屿，一直望到福海。

ai.en: At this height the AI has redrawn the layout freely, and the mountains on the horizon are its own: take it as an impression, not a map.
ai.zh: 在这样的高度，AI 自由地重画了布局，地平线上的山也是它画的：请把它当作印象，而不是地图。

alt.en: AI picture: lakes and islands with halls among autumn trees seen from high above under an overcast sky, a large lake with an island hall beyond and hills on the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：阴天里从高空俯瞰秋树掩映的湖泊、岛屿和殿宇，远处是一片大湖和湖心的殿宇，地平线上有山。

title.en: The axis from above

text.en: Looking north from above the forecourt: 大宫门 Da Gongmen, the court, 正大光明 Zhengda Guangming, then the Front Lake and the emperor's island.
text.zh: 从前院上空向北：大宫门、院子、正大光明殿，然后是前湖和九洲清晏。

ai.en: The halls' places follow our model, but the AI has left out the canal and the second gate, 出入贤良门 Churu Xianliang Men, and coloured the roofs: the album of 1744 paints them grey.
ai.zh: 建筑位置依照我们的模型，但 AI 漏掉了水渠和第二道门出入贤良门，还给屋顶上了颜色：1744 年的画页里它们是灰瓦。

alt.en: AI picture: a palace axis seen from high above on a summer morning, a gate with a green roof, a wide court, a great hall with a yellow roof, then a lake and an island with halls.
alt.zh: AI 图像：夏日清晨从高空俯瞰宫殿中轴线：绿顶的宫门、宽阔的院子、黄顶的大殿，然后是湖和岛上的殿宇。

title.en: 福海 Fu Hai in spring

text.en: 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai from high over the south of the lake, the shores in blossom, an early spring morning.
text.zh: 早春清晨，从福海南部上空望蓬岛瑶台，岸边花开。

ai.en: The island's place follows our model; the halls, the blossom and the boats are the AI's.
ai.zh: 小岛的位置依照我们的模型；殿宇、花和船是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: an island with grey- and yellow-roofed halls in a still lake seen from above, pink blossom and willows on its shore, two boats on the water.
alt.zh: AI 图像：从高处俯瞰平静湖中的小岛，岛上有灰顶和黄顶的殿宇，岸边是粉色的花和柳树，水上有两条船。

title.en: The European palaces from above

text.en: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang from above the west on an autumn afternoon, the strip of the European palaces running on behind it.
text.zh: 秋日午后，从西面上空望海晏堂，西洋楼的建筑在它后面向东排开。

ai.en: The west front, its stair and the basin follow our model; what lies behind it, the trees and the carriages are the AI's free drawing.
ai.zh: 西立面、楼梯和水池依照我们的模型；后面的部分、树木和马车是 AI 自由画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a European-style stone palace seen from above in autumn, its double stair around a fountain basin, a long axis of fountains and pavilions behind among golden trees.
alt.zh: AI 图像：秋天从高处俯瞰一座欧式石砌宫殿，双跑楼梯环抱喷泉水池，后面金黄的树林间是一条排列着喷泉和亭子的长轴线。

title.en: 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing on a spring morning

text.en: The terraces of Fanghu Shengjing (YM29) over their inlet north-east of 福海 Fu Hai, from high above the water to the south. Our model of Round 24 sets nine two-storey towers in three ranges on the upper terrace, joined by galleries, with pavilions out on the water, after the album leaf of 1744 and the texts.
text.zh: 从南面高空隔水望福海东北的方壶胜境（YM29）。我们第 24 轮的模型在上层台上排了三排共九座两层楼阁，以游廊相连，水中还有亭子，依据 1744 年的画页和文献。

ai.en: The towers, terraces and pavilions stand where our model puts them, and their coloured roofs follow the leaf. The boats, the blossom, the villages and smoke beyond the wall and the far mountains are the AI's.
ai.zh: 楼阁、台和亭子的位置依照我们的模型，彩色屋顶依照画页。船、花、墙外的村庄和炊烟以及远山都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: tiered halls with yellow, green and blue glazed roofs on a white terrace jutting into a lake, a small pavilion on a square platform in the water, boats with wakes, blossom and willows on the shores, a long red wall at the right and fields and hills beyond.
alt.zh: AI 图像：湖湾中伸出一座白石台，台上是层层殿阁，屋顶有黄、绿、蓝色琉璃，水中方台上有一座小亭，湖上有船，岸边是花和柳树，右边是一道长长的红墙，远处是田野和山。

title.en: The towers of 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing across the water, an autumn afternoon
title.zh: 秋日午后隔水望方壶胜境

text.en: At eye level about 70 m south of the terraces, looking north across the inlet: the pavilion 迎薰亭 Yingxun Ting on its square terrace with steps down to the water, the lower terrace and the towers behind (YM29). Every height in our model is a guess, grade C.
text.zh: 在台基南面约 70 米处平视，隔着水湾向北看：方台上的迎薰亭和通到水面的台阶，后面是下层台和楼阁（YM29）。我们模型中的高度都是推测，C 级。

ai.en: The terraces, the pavilion and the towers follow our model, and the leaf's yellow, purple-brown and blue tiles come through in the AI's roofs. The trees in front, the barge, the lotus and the visitors are its own.
ai.zh: 台、亭子和楼阁依照我们的模型，画页上的黄、紫褐、蓝色琉璃在 AI 画的屋顶上也看得出来。前景的树、游船、荷叶和游人都是它画的。

alt.en: AI picture: framed by golden autumn trees, a pavilion with a yellow roof on a white marble platform in a lake, steps down to the water, a barge beside it, and behind it a long terrace with tiered halls under yellow, purple-brown and blue roofs.
alt.zh: AI 图像：金黄的秋树环绕着画面，湖中白石方台上有一座黄顶亭子，台阶通到水面，旁边停着游船，后面长长的台基上是层层殿阁，屋顶是黄、紫褐和蓝色。

title.en: 正觉寺 Zhengjue Si, a summer evening

text.en: The Tibetan Buddhist temple of 绮春园 Qichun Yuan (QC11), from high above its gate, looking north along its axis to the halls in their courts. It is the one group of the gardens that came through 1860 (S145); our model of Round 28 follows the plan S01 and what still stands.
text.zh: 从山门上空沿中轴向北俯瞰绮春园的藏传佛教寺院正觉寺（QC11）和各进院落中的殿宇。它是园中唯一保存过 1860 年的一组建筑（S145）；我们第 28 轮的模型依照平面图 S01 和现存的建筑。

ai.en: The wall, the courts and the halls' places follow our model. The road and carts outside the wall, the villages, the smoke and the far mountains are the AI's, and so are the shapes of the lakes on either side.
ai.zh: 围墙、院落和殿宇的位置依照我们的模型。墙外的路和马车、村庄、炊烟和远山都是 AI 画的，两侧湖岸的形状也是。

alt.en: AI picture: a walled temple of red walls and grey and glazed roofs seen from high above in warm evening light, courts on an axis among willows, lakes with boats either side, a road with carts along the red outer wall in front and hills on the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：傍晚暖光中从高空俯瞰一座红墙围合的寺院，灰瓦和琉璃屋顶，院落沿中轴排列，掩映在柳树中，两侧湖上有船，前面红色外墙边的路上有马车，地平线上是山。

title.en: 鸿慈永祜 Hongci Yonghu, the ancestral temple, an autumn morning

text.en: The precinct of the ancestral temple 安佑宫 Anyou Gong (YM17) in the north-west of 圆明园 Yuanming Yuan, from high above the south, looking north along its axis: the moats with their bridges, the gate and the great hall under its yellow roof. Our model of Round 27 follows the plan S01, the album leaf of 1744 and Malone's walk over the ruin.
text.zh: 从南面高空沿中轴向北俯瞰圆明园西北部的祖庙安佑宫（YM17）：护城河和桥、宫门以及黄瓦大殿。我们第 27 轮的模型依照平面图 S01、1744 年的画页和后人对遗址的记述。

ai.en: The walls, the moats, the gates and the halls follow our model; the yellow tile follows the leaf. The villages, the smoke, the carts on the road and the mountains are the AI's.
ai.zh: 围墙、河道、门和殿宇依照我们的模型，黄琉璃瓦依照画页。村庄、炊烟、路上的车和远山都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a walled temple precinct with yellow and green glazed roofs seen from high above on a clear autumn morning, moats with white bridges and balustrades around it, autumn trees, lakes at the right and hills behind.
alt.zh: AI 图像：晴朗的秋日清晨从高空俯瞰一处围墙环绕的祖庙，屋顶是黄绿琉璃，四周河道上有白石桥和栏杆，秋树环绕，右边是湖，后面是山。

title.en: The gate of 安佑宫 Anyou Gong, an autumn morning

text.en: At eye level on the axis, looking north over the marble bridge of the inner moat (白玉石桥, YM17-07) to the gate 安佑门 Anyou Men (YM17-06) on its terrace, a side hall behind the red wall. Malone counted five bridges over each moat; our model draws them where the plan breaks the moats.
text.zh: 在中轴线上平视，越过内河上的白玉石桥（YM17-07）向北看台基上的安佑门（YM17-06），红墙后是配殿。据记载每道河上各有五座桥；我们的模型把它们画在平面图上河道断开的地方。

ai.en: The bridge, the gate and the wall follow our model loosely. The lions, the painted beams and the figures are the AI's.
ai.zh: 桥、门和墙大致依照我们的模型。石狮、彩画和人物是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a gate hall with a yellow glazed roof and red columns on a white marble terrace with stone lions, red walls either side, a white marble bridge with carved balustrades over still water in front, a few figures in Qing dress, cypresses and morning haze.
alt.zh: AI 图像：白石台基上一座黄琉璃瓦、红柱的门殿，前有石狮，两侧是红墙，近处平静的水面上有一座雕栏白石桥，几个穿清代服饰的人，柏树和晨雾。

title.en: 狮子林 Shizi Lin, the rockery garden, in late spring

text.en: The rockery garden of 1772 in 长春园 Changchun Yuan (CC13), after the garden of the same name in Suzhou, from high above the south: the pool with its rock mountain and peaks, the halls round the courts. No picture of it standing is known; our model of Round 29 rests on the plan S01 and Qianlong's sixteen poems, which name each scene.
text.zh: 从南面高空俯瞰长春园中 1772 年仿苏州狮子林建成的叠石园林（CC13）：水池、石山和峰石，以及院落四周的殿宇。目前不知道有它完好时的图像；我们第 29 轮的模型依据平面图 S01 和乾隆的十六首诗，诗中写到每一景。

ai.en: The pool, the rockery and the halls' places follow our model. The European palaces at the back are drawn loosely, and the fields, the villages, the smoke and the hills are the AI's.
ai.zh: 水池、石山和殿宇的位置依照我们的模型。后面的西洋楼画得很随意，田野、村庄、炊烟和山都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a garden of pale rockeries, ponds and grey-roofed halls with one green and yellow glazed hall, seen from high above in late spring, blossom and willows along canals, a lake behind and fields reaching to distant hills.
alt.zh: AI 图像：暮春时从高空俯瞰一座园林，浅色的叠石、水池和灰瓦殿宇中有一座黄绿琉璃顶的殿，河边是花和柳树，后面是湖，田野一直延伸到远山。

title.en: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze, a summer afternoon

text.en: The maze of the European palaces (XY04), from high above the south: carved brick walls round a pavilion raised in the centre. Our model of Round 26 traces its 171 walls on the plan S01 and sets them in the block measured where today's rebuilt maze stands (S310).
text.zh: 从南面高空俯瞰西洋楼的迷宫黄花阵（XY04）：雕花砖墙环绕着中央高台上的亭子。我们第 26 轮的模型在平面图 S01 上描出 171 道墙，并按今天复建迷宫处测得的范围（S310）放置。

ai.en: The AI kept the walled block and a pavilion in the middle, but drew the walls as terraces and the pavilion as a Chinese tower: plate 5 of 1786 shows a domed European pavilion on a drum. The Chinese halls in front stand where 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, a European palace, stood; the canal and the boats are its own too.
ai.zh: AI 保留了围合的方块和中间的亭子，但把墙画成了台阶状，把亭子画成了中式楼阁：1786 年的第五幅铜版画上是一座鼓座上的穹顶西式亭子。前面的中式殿宇所在的位置原本是西式宫殿谐奇趣，河道和船也是它画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a large maze of low stepped walls seen from above in summer, a tiered pavilion with a golden roof in the centre, grey-roofed halls in front, a yellow-roofed hall behind, a canal with boats at the right and fields to the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：夏日从高处俯瞰一座由低矮阶状墙组成的大迷宫，中央是一座金顶的多层亭子，前面是灰瓦殿宇，后面有一座黄顶殿，右边河上有船，田野一直延伸到天边。

title.en: 螺蛳牌楼 Luosi Pailou, at the east end of the European palaces
title.zh: 西洋楼东端的螺蛳牌楼

text.en: At eye level beside the gate 螺蛳牌楼 Luosi Pailou (XY13), between the perspective hill and 方河 Fang He, a summer afternoon. Our model of Round 30 reads its arch, the carved vines on its piers and its two towers off plate 19 of 1786 (0.19 m rms over 41 points); its size rests on a weak module, grade C.
text.zh: 夏日午后，在螺蛳牌楼（XY13）旁平视，它位于线法山和方河之间。我们第 30 轮的模型依据 1786 年的第十九幅铜版画读出拱门、柱墩上的雕花藤蔓和两座塔楼（41 个点，均方根误差 0.19 米）；它的尺寸依据一个不太可靠的模数，C 级。

ai.en: The arch, the piers with their twisted vines and the two capped towers follow our model and the plate. The weathered grey of the stone, the pools around it and the two people are the AI's.
ai.zh: 拱门、缠藤的柱墩和两座带顶的塔楼依照我们的模型和铜版画。石头的灰暗旧色、四周的水池和两个人物都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a carved stone gate in European style with a round arch, twisted columns wound with vines and two small towers with domed caps, standing on a paved walk between still pools, pines and willows around and two people walking towards it.
alt.zh: AI 图像：一座西式雕花石门，有半圆拱、缠着藤蔓的螺旋柱和两座圆顶小塔，立在两片静水之间的石板路上，四周是松树和柳树，两个人正向它走去。

title.en: The gardens on a spring morning, in mist

text.en: From high above the south-west, looking north-east over the lakes and islands of 圆明园 Yuanming Yuan towards 福海 Fu Hai, the shores in blossom and mist lying on the water.
text.zh: 从西南面高空向东北俯瞰圆明园的湖泊和岛屿，一直望向福海，岸边花开，水面上浮着薄雾。

ai.en: Only the camera comes from our model. At this height the AI has redrawn the lakes, islands and halls freely, and the blossom, the boats, the villages and the hills are its own: take it as an impression, not a map.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型。在这样的高度，AI 自由地重画了湖、岛和殿宇，花、船、村庄和山都是它画的：请把它当作印象，而不是地图。

alt.en: AI picture: lakes and islands with yellow- and grey-roofed halls seen from high above at dawn in spring, pink blossom along the shores, mist on the water, villages with smoke and fields fading into haze and hills.
alt.zh: AI 图像：春天清晨从高空俯瞰湖泊和岛屿，黄顶和灰顶的殿宇，岸边是粉色的花，水面上有薄雾，村庄里升起炊烟，田野渐渐隐入雾和远山。

title.en: A grey autumn day over the gardens

text.en: From high above the west, looking east over the lakes and islands of 圆明园 Yuanming Yuan, with 福海 Fu Hai and its island hall at the top of the picture.
text.zh: 从西面高空向东俯瞰圆明园的湖泊和岛屿，画面上方是福海和湖心的殿宇。

ai.en: Only the camera comes from our model. The AI has redrawn the layout, put a European-style palace at the right where none stood (the European palaces lay to the north-east, at the left of this view) and added the villages and the smoke; the mountains on the horizon are invented too, for east of the gardens lies the plain.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型。AI 重画了布局，在右边画了一座本不存在的西式宫殿（西洋楼在东北，即画面的左边），还加了村庄和炊烟；地平线上的山也是想象的，因为园林东面是平原。

alt.en: AI picture: islands crowded with halls among red and gold autumn trees in a lake seen from high above under a grey sky, a large lake with an island hall beyond, a pale European-style palace at the right, villages and fields, hills on the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：阴天从高空俯瞰湖中的岛屿，殿宇密布，掩映在红黄色的秋树中，远处一片大湖，湖心有殿，右边有一座浅色的西式宫殿，还有村庄和田野，地平线上有山。

title.en: A night of lanterns over the gardens, imagined

text.en: From high above the south-east under a full moon, looking north-west over 福海 Fu Hai and its island towards the Western Hills, lanterns along the shores and the walls. The night is imagined, not a recorded festival.
text.zh: 满月之下，从东南面高空向西北俯瞰福海和湖心岛，一直望到西山，岸边和墙上挂满灯笼。这是想象的夜景，不是记载中的某个节日。

ai.en: Only the camera comes from our model, and the hills do stand to the north-west. The lights, the fireworks, the boats and the layout are the AI's; in our 3D view the lanterns are a guess too, grade C.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型，西山确实在西北方。灯光、烟花、船和布局都是 AI 画的；在我们的三维视图里，灯笼也是推测，C 级。

alt.en: AI picture: the gardens seen from high above at night under a full moon, lines of warm lanterns along shores, walls and bridges, a square lake with a lit island in the middle, two small fireworks and dark hills on the horizon.
alt.zh: AI 图像：满月下从高空俯瞰夜色中的园林，岸边、墙上和桥上排着暖色的灯笼，一片方形的湖中间是灯火通明的小岛，远处有两朵小烟花，地平线上是黑色的山。

title.en: 福海 Fu Hai under a full moon, imagined

text.en: From the shore, a few metres up, looking north-west across the water towards 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai (YM32) on a night of lanterns. The night is imagined, not a recorded festival.
text.zh: 从岸边略高处向西北隔水望蓬岛瑶台（YM32），夜里挂满灯笼。这是想象的夜景，不是记载中的某个节日。

ai.en: Only the viewpoint comes from our model, and loosely. The hall on the near shore, the lanterns, the floating lights and the people are the AI's.
ai.zh: 只有视点来自我们的模型，而且只是大致如此。近岸的殿宇、灯笼、水上的灯和人物都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a hall with red lanterns on a lake shore at night, a full moon and its reflection, floating lights and lotus leaves on the dark water, people walking along a lantern-lit embankment, pines and willows.
alt.zh: AI 图像：夜晚湖岸上一座挂着红灯笼的殿宇，一轮满月倒映在水中，黑色的水面上漂着灯和荷叶，人们沿着挂满灯笼的堤岸走着，四周是松树和柳树。

title.en: The European palaces at dusk, late autumn

text.en: From about 100 m above the west of 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang (XY08), looking east along the strip of the European palaces in the last light.
text.zh: 从海晏堂（XY08）西面约 100 米高处，在暮色中向东望西洋楼一带。

ai.en: Only the camera and the look of the stone fronts come from our model and the copperplates of 1786. The palace in the middle is the AI's blend of 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang and 远瀛观 Yuanying Guan, and the Chinese halls, the lake and the bridge round it are its own; the lanterns and the people are imagined.
ai.zh: 只有视点和石砌立面的样子来自我们的模型和 1786 年的铜版画。中间的宫殿是 AI 把海晏堂和远瀛观混在一起画的，四周的中式殿宇、湖和桥也是它画的；灯笼和人物是想象的。

alt.en: AI picture: an ornate European-style stone palace with a clock gable and wide stairs seen from above at dusk, Chinese halls with glazed roofs in front, a moat with a round-arched bridge and lantern-lit boats at the right, autumn trees glowing under an orange sky.
alt.zh: AI 图像：黄昏时从高处看一座装饰繁复的欧式石砌宫殿，有钟面山花和宽大的台阶，前面是琉璃顶的中式殿宇，右边河上有圆拱桥和点灯的船，秋树在橙色的天空下闪着光。

title.en: 大水法 Da Shuifa, the Great Fountain, from above

text.en: From about 110 m over the court, looking north-north-east across the basin and its jets to the niche of the Great Fountain (XY10), with the hall of 远瀛观 Yuanying Guan (XY09) on its terrace behind.
text.zh: 从广场上空约 110 米处向北偏东看，越过水池和喷泉望大水法（XY10）的石龛，后面是台上的远瀛观（XY09）。

ai.en: The basin, the niche and the stairs follow our model of Round 15 and plate 15, loosely. The parterres in front, the yellow-roofed Chinese hall at the right, the canal with its boats and the people with parasols are the AI's.
ai.zh: 水池、石龛和台阶大致依照我们第 15 轮的模型和第十五幅铜版画。前面的花坛、右边的黄顶中式殿宇、河上的船和打伞的人都是 AI 画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a great fountain seen from above on a bright day, tall jets rising from a round basin before a carved stone niche, European-style palaces with green glazed roofs behind, clipped parterres in front, a yellow-roofed Chinese hall at the right and people with parasols.
alt.zh: AI 图像：晴天从高处俯瞰一座大型喷泉，圆形水池里水柱高喷，后面是雕花石龛，再后面是绿琉璃顶的欧式宫殿，前面是修剪整齐的花坛，右边是一座黄顶中式殿宇，还有打伞的人。

title.en: 大水法 Da Shuifa on a spring morning

text.en: At eye level in the court in front of the Great Fountain (XY10), looking north to the niche with its shell crest, the water steps and the basin with the stag and the hounds, blossom on either side.
text.zh: 在大水法（XY10）前的广场上平视，向北看顶上有贝壳的石龛、跌水台阶和有鹿与猎犬的水池，两侧花开。

ai.en: The niche, the steps and the basin follow our model and plate 15. The two towers of jets are missing and the AI has put clocks on the piers; the blossom, the men sweeping and the visitors are imagined.
ai.zh: 石龛、台阶和水池依照我们的模型和第十五幅铜版画。两座喷水塔没有画出来，AI 还在柱墩上画了钟；花、扫地的人和游人都是想象的。

alt.en: AI picture: a carved stone fountain niche crowned by a great shell, water running down its steps into a basin where bronze animals spout jets, pink and white blossom trees either side, a few people in Qing dress and two sweepers.
alt.zh: AI 图像：雕花石龛顶上是一只大贝壳，水沿台阶流进水池，池中的青铜动物喷着水，两侧是粉色和白色的花树，有几个穿清代服饰的人和两个扫地的人。

title.en: The strip of the European palaces from the south

text.en: From about 250 m above the lakes of 长春园 Changchun Yuan, looking north across the narrow strip where the European palaces stood along the garden's north wall (XY01 to XY15).
text.zh: 从长春园湖面上空约 250 米处向北，望沿园北墙排开的狭长的西洋楼一带（XY01 至 XY15）。

ai.en: At this height the AI has redrawn the palaces and their fountains freely, so take it as an impression, not a map; the fields, the villages and the hills beyond the wall are its own.
ai.zh: 在这样的高度，AI 自由地重画了这些宫殿和喷泉，请把它当作印象，而不是地图；墙外的田野、村庄和山都是它画的。

alt.en: AI picture: a broad view from high above of a lake with boats and bridges in front, wooded grounds with scattered halls, a row of pale European-style palaces with fountains and pools in the middle distance, and fields reaching to hills under a soft sky.
alt.zh: AI 图像：从高空远望，近处湖上有船和桥，林地中散布着殿宇，中景是一排浅色的欧式宫殿和喷泉水池，田野一直延伸到柔和天空下的远山。
